Package com.robojacks.lib.drive

Interface TankDriveSubsystem

All Superinterfaces:
Subsystem
All Known Implementing Classes:
DriveSubsystem, DriveSubsystem
public interface TankDriveSubsystem extends Subsystem
What the library's drive commands (TurnToHeading, DriveToPoint, DriveDistance and the tuning tests) need from your drivetrain. Implement it on your Drivetrain subsystem.
